correctness.rationale: Reconstructed actual M^13=I+3B with B rows (91,141,168),(168,259,309),(309,477,568), and residues T_r+1 divisible by 3 precisely r=3,8,10. For each the 3-adic analytic interpolation g_r(z)=(1+e1^T M^r(I+3B)^z v)/3 has isometric difference g_r(a)-g_r(b)=(a-b)*(c_r+3u) with c_r=2 mod3, by the binomial-difference valuation j-v3(j!)>=2 for j>=2. This ensures a unique alpha_r and exact valuation law. Shifted negative-index recurrence T_-3=-1 gives alpha_10=-1. The three permitted mod13 residue supports and two of three lifts at each level imply least period 13*3^t (exclude q/3 and q/13); counting gives density and discrepancy. Independent direct iteration checked levels t=1..4 and least periods. Finite checks are corroborative.
correctness.residual_risks: Only standard Tribonacci T_n+1 at p=3. Noninteger alpha_3/alpha_8 defined by unique 3-adic lifts; no rationality assertion or all-prime extension.
